paragraphs: A live campus accessibility map that suggests obstacle types from photos and reroutes wheelchair, crutch and low-vision users the moment a barrier is reported or cleared. This is a working prototype for one fictional campus (Ashgrove University). The build plan is in PLAN.md; the rules the code follows are in CLAUDE.md.
hash of the image, so the demo is repeatable. It is always labelled "AI suggestion (demo)".
